title: Bakuretsu Hunter R
overview:
That Bakuretsu Hunter has become an adventure RPG: R!

Based on the Bakuretsu Hunter manga and anime, Bakuretsu Hunter R follows Carrot and his fellow hunters as they protect innocent people from wicked sorcerers. The story unfolds in visual novel scenes full of the series' trademark fan service, broken up by hot-blooded turn-based battles.

In combat, Carrot, Marron, Gateau, Chocolat and Tira fight side by side, with Marron the party's only spellcaster. Each episode has a set number of battles, and there are no levels to grind. Minigames, including a cliff-climbing challenge, round out the package.

- Story scenes with anime-style artwork
- Turn-based RPG battles with the full hunter team
- Bonus minigames
- 1-2 players

あの爆れつハンターがアドベンチャーRロープレになった！
